name: soundbridge/involvement
title: Get Involved Pathways
description: Interactive ways to donate, volunteer, partner, teach, or sponsor.

default.label: Donate
default.title: Fund Access to Music
default.body: Your donation directly supports student scholarships, program materials, and educator stipends. Every dollar keeps SoundBridge accessible to families who need it most.
items: $25 — Helps offset materials for one student

default.label: Volunteer
default.title: Give Your Time
default.body: Help with events, logistics, registration, and community outreach. No music experience is required — just a desire to make a difference.

default.label: Partner
default.title: Organizational Partnership
default.body: Partner organizations help SoundBridge reach more students through venue access, referrals, and co-programming.

default.label: Teach
default.title: Join Our Faculty
default.body: Professional musicians and experienced music educators can help lead SoundBridge programs and workshops.
items: Experience with youth or community settings

default.label: Sponsor
default.title: Sponsor a Program
default.body: Business sponsors provide meaningful, visible community impact tied to programs, events, or scholarships.
